newsitem.title: LATVIA: VALMIERA GLASSFIBRE ISSUE PRICE IN MID-JUNE.
newsitem.headline: VALMIERA GLASSFIBRE ISSUE PRICE IN MID-JUNE.

text.p: Valmiera Glassfibre factory said on Tuesday that the price of its closed share issue, worth 1.127 million lats, will be set by the Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) by mid-June.
"We will submit the necessary documents to the LPA on May 30, which means the agency will have two weeks to set the price," Imants Saulitis, Valmiera's finance manager, told Reuters.

The issue, with a nominal value of one lat, was registered by the factory in the company register on May 20, formalising Valmiera's share capital boost to 12.62 million lats from 11.5 million lats, Saulitis said.
The issue was based on the amount of debt that the company owed to the state and which was capitalised.
The LPA is to decide on the price of this issue based on the company's average bourse price during tha last quarter.
Valmiera, a leading secondary list stock, rose today to 1.61 lats from 1.58 lats, having hovered above the two lat line earlier in the year.
The issue will be first offered to the existing shareholders and the board will decide on the subscription period.
Some 74 percent of the price will be paid in cash and the remainder in vouchers.
